sources.note: Read 2026-11-17 through a summarizing fetch of a training provider's syllabus page that restates the objectives in its own words (CompTIA's PDF on comptia.jp refused automated reading). Domains and weights as above. Relevant restated lines: change control (identify when a formal change request is needed; assess impacts on scope, schedule, cost, quality and risk; differentiate scope creep from approved change); meeting management (an agenda with timeboxes; attendees by decision rights; document decisions and action items); IT governance and change control (CAB/CCB; rollback readiness; post-change validation). The objective wording here is the course seed's; CompTIA's own wording is to verify.

sources.cite: Adrienne Watt, Project Management, 2nd edition (BCcampus Open Textbooks, CC BY-SA 4.0), chapter 13 Procurement Management
sources.note: Read 2026-11-17 through a summarizing fetch of the LibreTexts copy. Fixed-price fits when 'the scope of work is very clear and not likely to change', with the risk mostly on the contractor; cost-reimbursable is 'most often used when the scope of work or the costs for performing the work are not well known', with the risk mostly on the project; under time and materials 'the project, rather than the contractor, assumes the risk', and such contracts typically carry a not-to-exceed amount. After award the team tracks the contractor's performance against the contract's criteria and may invoke the contract's terms when it underperforms.

sources.cite: Abdullah Oguz, Project Management, 2nd edition (MSL Academic Endeavors, CC BY-NC 4.0), 11.3 Earned Value Management
sources.note: Read 2026-11-17 (through a summarizing fetch, by this round's first builder). SPI = EV / PV and CPI = EV / AC, below 1.0 meaning behind schedule and over cost for the work done. The estimate at completion used here, BAC / CPI, is the common formula for a variance expected to continue; it was not quoted in that read (to verify).

The city, the contact center, the vendors, the budget, the weekly planned value, the costs and progress each event moves and the trust gauges are teaching figures for exam practice, not measured values.
